tableUser.Name: Table Display user
tableUser.Hint: The user account logged in on the touchscreen table. That client becomes a Table Display: decluttered, touch-optimized, and the only client where touch handlers run (unless a client forces them on).

tableAllowUndeclutter.Name: Table may un-declutter
tableAllowUndeclutter.Hint: Show the declutter toggle button on the Table Display so it can reveal the sidebar and hotbar. Off keeps the table permanently decluttered.

viewSync.Name: GM view sync
viewSync.Hint: Let the GM drive the Table Display's pan and zoom. Manual: push with the GM button or keybinding. Follow: the table follows the GM's view continuously.

compatMode.Name: Compatibility mode
compatMode.Hint: Ignore touches that start on elements of known conflicting modules (Monk's Token Bar and others) and on the selectors below, so their own drag handling works.

conflictSelectors.Name: Extra conflict selectors
conflictSelectors.Hint: Comma-separated CSS selectors where touch handlers are disabled in compatibility mode.

touchMode.Name: Touch handlers on this client
touchMode.Hint: Auto: only on the Table Display client. On: always (single-window touch setups). Off: never.

tableDisplay.Name: Force Table Display on this client
tableDisplay.Hint: Treat this browser as the Table Display even if it is not logged in as the Table user.

uiScale.Name: Touch target scale
uiScale.Hint: Scales scene controls, sidebar tabs and token HUD buttons on this client. 1 = Foundry default.

panSmoothing.Name: Pan/zoom smoothing
panSmoothing.Hint: 0 = raw, higher = smoother but laggier. Raise on cheap infrared frames that jitter.

deadzone.Name: Two-finger deadzone (px)
deadzone.Hint: Finger movement below this distance is ignored before a pan or pinch starts.

tapTolerance.Name: Tap tolerance (px)
tapTolerance.Hint: How far a finger may drift and still count as a tap.

longPressMs.Name: Long-press time (ms)
longPressMs.Hint: Hold this long on a token to run the long-press action, or on empty space to start the ruler.

longPressAction.Name: Long-press on token
longPressAction.Hint: What a long-press on a token does. A short tap only ever selects.

showButton.Name: Show floating declutter button
showButton.Hint: Show the round floating button that toggles declutter mode on this client.

declutter.Name: Declutter mode
declutter.Hint: Hide sidebar, navigation, hotbar and players list on this client.

Keys.SyncView: Push my view to the Table Display

Notify.NoTable: No Table Display user is set.
